commits.subject: fix(scripts): make each de-umbrella wave atomic — it now repairs its own cascade
commits.summary:
**The defect.** The driver build-gated between waves but treated a failed build as a warning to print and move past, so a cascade could travel into the next wave and out to the user. Three times today the same class of breakage escaped that way: 35 of this projects modules declare no Mathlib import at all, inherit the library transitively, and are invisible to the minimal-import probe because nothing in their own text says what they need.

**The fix.** `build_and_repair` now reads the broken modules straight out of the build log, restores a bare `import Mathlib` to each — which restores exactly the environment they were inheriting, so it cannot fail — and rebuilds, up to four attempts, refusing to start the next wave until the current one is green. A wave is now atomic: it lands green or repairs itself to green. The campaign can be left running unattended.
